about_the_game:
Soulforge is a dark and atmospheric rogue-like dungeon crawler, blending intense, action-packed combat with immersive, narrative-driven exploration. Dive into forgotten ruins, wield a powerful yet dangerously corrupted blade, and uncover the chilling secrets that shattered an ancient kingdom.

MASTER THE SOULFORGE

Step into the role of a descendant tasked with reclaiming the scattered shards of the legendary Soulforge, a weapon that binds souls to steel. Balance devastating combat abilities with the constant threat of corruption, risking your very sanity with each powerful strike.

UNRAVEL ANCIENT PUZZLES

Delve into carefully designed puzzles and cryptic mysteries hidden within the ruins. Solve intricate riddles, activate ancient mechanisms, and unlock secret chambers to reveal powerful relics and forgotten truths. Each puzzle solved brings you closer to the heart of the kingdom's tragedy. 

NAVIGATE DEADLY DUNGEONS

Explore hand-crafted dungeons teeming with cunning traps, ruthless enemies, and hidden pathways. Every corner holds a new threat and a new discovery.

SEEK SANCTUARY IN HIDDEN HAVENS

Discover secret rooms and hidden sanctuaries scattered throughout your journey, from cozy fireplaces offering a brief rest, to chambers housing the mystical Tree of Life. Purify your character from accumulating corruption, regain your strength, and reflect upon the path ahead.

FORGE BONDS WITH FORGOTTEN SOULS 

Interact with vividly voiced characters, including restless spirits, cunning allies, and a sardonic, sentient sword eager to mock your every misstep. Deepen these relationships to reveal hidden lore and secrets that will guide your journey—or hasten your descent.

ENDLESS POWER, ENDLESS MADNESS

Permanent upgrades and customizable character builds ensure every attempt brings fresh challenges and new strategies. Face increasingly formidable foes, each encounter testing your skill, resolve, and grip on reality.

IMMERSIVE, DARKLY BEAUTIFUL WORLD

With hauntingly atmospheric environments, hand-crafted visuals, and a soundtracks, Soulforge invites you to lose yourself in a dark fantasy world between haunting beauty and creeping madness.
